description: This source file defines a handler class for Bedrock image editing, including methods for preparing requests, executing synchronous and asynchronous image edits, and transforming responses to OpenAI format. It integrates with HTTP clients, AWS credentials, and configuration classes to facilitate image editing API calls within a deep learning or AI project.
